learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn about yummy food and how it makes us strong and healthy!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: We eat lovely fruits and vegetables every day. They give us energy to play and jump! Apples and carrots are very good for you.
Drinking milk makes our bones big and strong. We should drink milk every day to grow tall.
Always wash your little hands before eating food. Clean hands keep the bad germs away so we stay happy.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Draw Your Happy Plate!
fun_activity.instructions: Take a blank paper and draw a big round plate. Draw your favorite fruit and color it beautifully!

quick_recap: ⭐ Good food gives us energy to play all day.
⭐ We must drink milk and water to stay strong.
⭐ Always wash your hands before eating yummy food.
